edges.reason: onlyCREATOR compares msg.sender against the stored creatorAddress, a trust decision driven by caller input.
The AccessControl constructor writes msg.sender into creatorAddress, making the caller the privileged owner.
onlyCREATOR reads creatorAddress to authorize privileged functions.
onlySERAPHIM looks up seraphims[msg.sender], gating privileged data writes.
onlySERAPHIM reads the seraphims mapping to decide access.
Constructor execution sets the creatorAddress access-control root.
leaderboardId parameter flows into claimMedals and its bounds check.
DataContacts parameter flows into the wiring function.
DataContacts parameter flows into the wiring function.
DataContacts parameter flows into the wiring function.
DataContacts assigns the supplied address to angelCardDataContract.
DataContacts assigns the supplied address to medalDataContract.
DataContacts assigns the supplied address to sponsoredLeaderboardDataContract.
onlyCREATOR gates DataContacts, which can repoint all external contract addresses.
claimMedals reads angelCardDataContract to build the IAngelCardData interface.
claimMedals reads medalDataContract to build the IMedalData interface.
claimMedals reads sponsoredLeaderboardDataContract to build the leaderboard interface.
claimMedals performs an external call to getLeaderboard on a state-variable-controlled address.
leaderboardId is forwarded into the external getLeaderboard call.
endTime is destructured from the getLeaderboard return values.
isLive is destructured from the getLeaderboard return values.
prize is destructured from the getLeaderboard return values.
medalsClaimed flag is destructured from the getLeaderboard return values.
now (block.timestamp) is compared to endTime, making claimability miner-influenced.
endTime participates in the timestamp comparison guard.
isLive gates whether claimMedals proceeds.
medalsClaimed is intended to prevent double claiming of the same leaderboard.
The assignment 'medalsClaimed = true' overwrites the guard variable instead of testing it, permanently defeating the duplicate-claim check.
The broken assignment always evaluates true inside the if-condition, so the intended revert is either always taken or the guard is corrupted.
setMedalsClaimed is an external call executed before any medals are minted, giving the callee control flow mid-execution.
The call target is the sponsoredLeaderboardDataContract state variable.
claimMedals performs repeated external getAngel calls on the angel card data contract.
The angel id obtained from the leaderboard team is passed to getAngel.
owner1 is the owner returned by getAngel for rank 0.
owner2 is the owner returned by getAngel for rank 1.
owner3 is the owner returned by getAngel for rank 2.
owner4 is the owner returned by getAngel for rank 3.
prize selects which medal series ids are minted.
owner1 is the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner2 is the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner3 is the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner4 is the recipient argument of _createMedal.
claimMedals calls the external medal contract multiple times, so a malicious medalDataContract could re-enter before state is settled.
addSERAPHIM performs an unchecked increment of the seraphim counter.
The counter arithmetic mutates totalSeraphims without overflow protection.
removeSERAPHIM performs an unchecked decrement of the seraphim counter.
_newSeraphim parameter flows into addSERAPHIM.
_oldSeraphim parameter flows into removeSERAPHIM.
_isMaintaining parameter controls the maintenance flag through a privileged function.
onlyCREATOR gates addSERAPHIM.
onlyCREATOR gates removeSERAPHIM.
onlyCREATOR gates updateMaintenanceMode.
updateMaintenanceMode writes isMaintenanceMode.
getRandomNumber derives its output from block.number/blockhash, i.e. miner-influenced chain state.
maxRandom parameter is used in the modulo range computation.
min parameter is used in the modulo range computation.
privateAddress parameter is added into the pseudo-random seed.

normalization_plan.reason: leaderboardId is only meaningful as the input selector of the core claimMedals function.
_angelCardDataContract only exists to be written into state by DataContacts.
_medalDataContract only exists to be written into state by DataContacts.
_sponsoredLeaderboardDataContract only exists to be written into state by DataContacts.
endTime is a transient decode target of the external call made inside claimMedals.
isLive is a transient decode target used only for the claimMedals guard.
medalsClaimed is a transient flag that feeds the broken access guard in claimMedals.
prize is only consumed to pick the medal series passed to the _createMedal external call.
angel is a transient index passed directly into the external getAngel call.
owner1 is only used as the _createMedal recipient argument.
owner2 is only used as the _createMedal recipient argument.
owner3 is only used as the _createMedal recipient argument.
owner4 is only used as the _createMedal recipient argument.
maxRandom is only consumed by getRandomNumber.
min is only consumed by getRandomNumber.
privateAddress is only consumed by getRandomNumber.
